crash.title: Something failed while showing the screen
crash.message: The app ran into an unexpected problem. You can retry or go back to the start.

welcome.title: Welcome to GithubDesk
welcome.subtitle: Open a repository to get started.
welcome.openDescription: Pick a folder that already has a Git repository.
welcome.createDescription: Start a new project from scratch.
welcome.cloneDescription: Download a repository from its address.

empty.title: No repositories yet
empty.description: Open, create or clone one and it will show up here.

clone.title: Clone repository
clone.description: Download a copy of the repository to your computer.

create.title: Create repository
create.description: Create a new folder with an empty Git repository.
create.name: Project name

empty.title: No branches yet
empty.description: Make your first commit and the branch will show up here.

createDialog.title: New branch
createDialog.description: Create a branch from where you are now.
createDialog.name: Branch name
createDialog.descriptionAt: The branch will be created from commit {{target}}.

renameDialog.title: Rename {{name}}
renameDialog.description: The new name only changes on your computer until you publish the branch.
renameDialog.name: New name

deleteDialog.title: Delete branch {{name}}
deleteDialog.description: The branch will be removed from your computer. Commits stay safe as long as they are in another branch.
deleteDialog.loss: The branch will stop existing on your computer. The remote copy, if any, is not touched.

forceDelete.title: Force delete {{name}}
forceDelete.description: Git warned that this branch has commits that are not in any other branch.
forceDelete.loss: Commits that only exist in this branch will lose their reference and be lost.
forceDelete.noUndo: You will not be able to recover them from the app.

discard.descriptionOne: The unstaged changes in {{path}} will be discarded.
discard.descriptionMany: The unstaged changes in {{count}} files will be discarded.
discard.lossTracked_one: {{count}} file will go back to how it was in its last staged or committed state.
discard.lossTracked_other: {{count}} files will go back to how they were in their last staged or committed state.
discard.lossUntracked_one: {{count}} new file will be deleted from disk.
discard.lossUntracked_other: {{count}} new files will be deleted from disk.

conflictBanner.description: Edit the files to resolve the conflicts and mark them as resolved.

empty.title: No changes
empty.description: Your working folder matches the last commit.
empty.ahead_one: You have {{count}} unpublished commit. Use Push to send it.
empty.ahead_other: You have {{count}} unpublished commits. Use Push to send them.

commit.label: Create commit
commit.titleTooLong: The summary has {{count}} characters; {{limit}} or fewer is recommended.

undo.title: Undo the last commit
undo.description: The commit "{{title}}" will leave the history. Its changes will be staged again and its message restored in the commit box.
undo.pushedWarning: This commit is already published. To reflect the change on the remote you will need to force push, which rewrites shared history.

diff.label: Differences in {{path}}

nothingSelected.title: Select a file
nothingSelected.description: Pick a file from the list to see its differences.

binary.title: Binary file
binary.description: Differences for this kind of file cannot be shown.

tooLarge.title: File too large
tooLarge.description: The differences exceed the limit for showing them without slowing down the app.

noContentChanges.title: No content changes
noContentChanges.description: Only something like the file mode changed.

diff.noNewline: No newline at end of file
diff.ignoreWhitespaceHint: Hides changes that are only whitespace. While active, hunks and lines cannot be staged.

empty.title: No commits yet
empty.description: Make your first commit and it will show up here.

history.selectFile: Pick a file from the commit to see its differences.

search.author: Author
search.content: Text that changed in the code
search.contentHint: Finds commits that added or removed that text. It can take a while on large repos.

view.label: History view
view.graphDisabled: Graph (turns on when filters are cleared)

sync.noRemoteHint: This repository has no remote configured.
sync.noCommitsHint: Make a first commit to be able to sync.

forcePushDialog.title: Push with safe overwrite
forcePushDialog.description: Your commits will replace the ones on the remote. Git only does it if nobody pushed new changes in the meantime (force-with-lease).
forcePushDialog.loss: Remote commits you do not have locally will be gone from that branch.

gitNotFound.title: Git is not installed
gitNotFound.message: We could not find Git on your computer. Install it and restart the app.

notARepository.title: This folder is not a repository
notARepository.message: The folder does not contain a Git repository. Pick another one or create a new one.

unsafeDirectory.title: Git does not trust this folder
unsafeDirectory.message: Git blocked the folder because it belongs to another user. Mark it as safe with git config --global --add safe.directory.

authenticationFailed.title: We could not sign you in
authenticationFailed.message: The server rejected your credentials. Check your session in Git Credential Manager and try again.

networkUnavailable.title: No connection to the server
networkUnavailable.message: The remote could not be reached. Check your internet connection.

remoteNotFound.title: Remote repository not found
remoteNotFound.message: The address does not exist or you do not have permission to see it.

remoteAhead.title: Your branch is behind
remoteAhead.message: The remote has commits you do not have. Pull before sending your changes.

noUpstream.title: The branch is not published yet
noUpstream.message: Publish the branch to be able to send and receive changes.

noRemote.title: No remote configured
noRemote.message: This repository is not connected to any remote.

mergeConflict.title: There are conflicts
mergeConflict.message: Git could not combine the changes automatically. Review the conflicted files.

unmergedFiles.title: There are unresolved files
unmergedFiles.message: Resolve the pending conflicts before continuing.

localChangesWouldBeOverwritten.title: You have unsaved changes
localChangesWouldBeOverwritten.message: This action would overwrite your local changes. Commit or discard them before continuing.

branchAlreadyExists.title: That branch already exists
branchAlreadyExists.message: Choose another name for the branch.

branchNotFullyMerged.title: The branch has unmerged commits
branchNotFullyMerged.message: Deleting it would lose commits that are not in any other branch.

branchCheckedOut.title: The current branch cannot be deleted
branchCheckedOut.message: Switch to another branch and try again.

branchNotFound.title: Branch not found
branchNotFound.message: The branch no longer exists. Refresh the list.

invalidName.title: Invalid name
invalidName.message: Use a name without spaces or special characters such as ~ ^ : ? * [ or \.

nothingToCommit.title: Nothing to commit
nothingToCommit.message: Stage at least one change before committing.

emptyCommitMessage.title: Missing summary
emptyCommitMessage.message: Write a summary for the commit.

identityMissing.title: Git does not know who you are
identityMissing.message: Set your name and email with git config --global user.name and git config --global user.email.

hookRejected.title: A hook rejected the commit
hookRejected.message: A Git script prevented the operation.

destinationNotEmpty.title: The destination folder is not empty
destinationNotEmpty.message: Choose an empty folder or a different name.

repositoryLocked.title: The repository is busy
repositoryLocked.message: Another Git process is working in this folder. Wait a few seconds.

unrelatedHistories.title: Unrelated histories
unrelatedHistories.message: The two branches share no history and Git does not combine them by default.

patchRejected.title: The file changed while you were choosing
patchRejected.message: The selected lines no longer match the file. Select them again.

noCommits.title: No commits yet
noCommits.message: Make your first commit to use this feature.

invalidInput.title: Invalid data
invalidInput.message: Check the data and try again.

io.title: File error
io.message: Could not read from or write to disk.

operationInProgress.title: An operation is already in progress
operationInProgress.message: Finish or cancel the current merge, cherry-pick, revert or rebase before starting another operation.

noOperationInProgress.title: No operation in progress
noOperationInProgress.message: The operation already finished or was cancelled. Refresh to see the current state.

unstagedChanges.title: There are unstaged changes
unstagedChanges.message: Stage the changes you want to keep or discard them before continuing.

commitBecameEmpty.title: The step has no changes left
commitBecameEmpty.message: After resolving, this commit changes nothing. You can skip the step.

mergeCommitNeedsParent.title: Choose a parent
mergeCommitNeedsParent.message: This commit is a merge. Choose which parent is the mainline.

tagAlreadyExists.title: The tag already exists
tagAlreadyExists.message: A tag with that name already exists. Pick another one.

nothingToStash.title: Nothing to stash
nothingToStash.message: You have no local changes to save to a stash.

stashNotFound.title: Stash not found
stashNotFound.message: The stash no longer exists. Refresh the list.

rebaseHasMerges.title: There are merges in the range
rebaseHasMerges.message: Interactive rebase does not support merge commits yet. Pick a more recent commit.

nothingToRebase.title: No commits to rearrange
nothingToRebase.message: Pick a commit older than the last one on your branch.

operation.title: {{name}} in progress
operation.resolveConflicts_one: Resolve the conflict in {{count}} file, then continue.
operation.resolveConflicts_other: Resolve the conflicts in {{count}} files, then continue.
operation.paused: The rebase stopped so you can edit the commit. Make your changes, stage them and continue.
operation.ready: No conflicts left. You can continue.

abortDialog.title: Cancel the {{name}}
abortDialog.description: You will go back to how things were before the {{name}} started.
abortDialog.loss: Everything you resolved so far will be discarded.

empty.title: No tags
empty.description: Create a tag to mark a release, for example v1.0.0.

createDialog.title: New tag
createDialog.descriptionHead: It will be created on the current commit.
createDialog.descriptionAt: It will be created on commit {{target}}.
createDialog.name: Name
createDialog.messageHint: Writing a message creates an annotated tag.

deleteDialog.title: Delete tag {{name}}
deleteDialog.description: It is only deleted on your computer. If you already pushed it, it stays on the remote.

deleteRemoteDialog.title: Delete {{name}} from the remote
deleteRemoteDialog.description: The tag will be removed from the remote for everyone.
deleteRemoteDialog.loss: Nobody else will be able to use this tag from the remote.

soft.done: Soft reset done: your changes are staged

mixed.done: Mixed reset done: your changes are unstaged

hard.title: Hard reset to {{hash}}
hard.description: The current branch will move to this commit and your working folder will match it.
hard.lossChanges: Changes you have not committed will be lost.
hard.lossCommits: Later commits will leave the branch. You can recover them from the reflog for a while.

revertMerge.title: Revert merge {{hash}}
revertMerge.description: A merge has several parents. Choose which one is the mainline you want to keep.

empty.title: No stashes
empty.description: Save your changes to a stash to set them aside without committing.

saveDialog.title: Save to stash
saveDialog.description: Set your current changes aside and leave the folder like the last commit.
saveDialog.includeUntracked: Include new files Git does not track yet

branchDialog.title: Create branch from stash
branchDialog.description: The branch is created at the commit where you stashed, the changes are applied and the stash is removed.

dropDialog.title: Delete the stash
dropDialog.loss: The changes saved in this stash will be lost.

pick.title: Pick two branches
pick.description: Select the base and the branch you want to compare with it.

same.title: It is the same branch
same.description: Pick two different branches to see their differences.

noChanges.title: No file differences
noChanges.description: The second branch changes nothing compared to the common ancestor.

noCommits.title: No exclusive commits
noCommits.description: All its commits are already in the other branch.

conflicts.unresolvedHint: Resolve every conflict before marking the file.

binary.title: This file cannot be edited here
binary.description: It is a binary file. Choose which version to keep.

tooLarge.description: The file is too large for the editor. Choose which version to keep.

deletedByUs.title: Your branch deleted this file
deletedByUs.description: The incoming version changed it. Decide whether to delete it or keep the changes.

deletedByThem.title: The incoming version deleted this file
deletedByThem.description: Your branch changed it. Decide whether to keep it or delete it.

bothDeleted.title: Both versions deleted this file
bothDeleted.description: Confirm the deletion to resolve the conflict.

rebase.description: From top to bottom, oldest to newest. Change each commit's action or reorder them.
rebase.messageCombinedHint: If left empty, Git joins the messages of the combined commits.
rebase.publishedWarning: Some commits were already pushed. After the rebase you will need a safe overwrite push and other people may need to redo their copy.

problems.firstSquash: The first kept commit cannot be combined into a previous one.
problems.emptyReword: Write the new message for the commits you are rewording.
